state.provider: Linux __airoha_npu_send_msg selects npu->cores[0], copies into core->buf, and publishes core->addr plus length to mailbox0. Probe allocates each core->buf with dmam_alloc_coherent and stores the returned DMA address in core->addr before loading either firmware image. MT7996 currently preflights/snapshots four reserved WLAN regions before either copy. No reset handle, prior-user containment or fresh boot identity publication exists in this driver.
state.native: The native bootstrap plan has six ordered base/bytes regions: binary, TXCHECK, PKT, TXPKT, BA, request. Request must be aligned, lie in the 0x80000000..0xbfffffff window, have 256 bytes and not overlap another region. V2 transport admits only exactly that request base. Current raw artifacts contain zero/unprovisioned plan/session/identity; test code separately seeds a synthetic request base 0x82000000.
state.requirements: Prepare the native six-region plan from actual immutable provider reserved-memory and coherent-mailbox inputs before copies. Reject invalid or overlapping request geometry before firmware acquisition or mailbox publication. Preserve non-MT7996 behavior and MT7996 optional-BA legacy behavior. This preparation is a software prerequisite, not a physical containment witness or completed loader installation.
